mission_fit.rationale: It meets the brief on several points: a manual, Toyota-simple mechanicals, cheap parts, strong resale, and a likely price inside the ideal band. It is a fair-weather, minimal-storage roadster rather than one of the named primary bridge candidates. It is fun and resellable, but less versatile than a Z3 3.0i or F56.

logistics.rationale: Castle Rock, CO is a fly-out-and-drive-home trip of roughly 1,200 miles. PPI access before bidding is not stated, so an inspector must be arranged within the auction window. CA registration should be straightforward.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: It combines the 2003 facelift with the heated glass rear window, a true 5-speed rather than SMT, low claimed miles, and apparent stock, one-family originality. Silver is a common colour.

seller_questions: Can you post or send the Carfax report so the odometer readings can be checked over time?
Do you have dated service receipts, especially oil changes, coolant, brake fluid and transaxle fluid, and when were they last done?
How much oil does it use between changes? Can you give quarts added over a known mileage?
Can you provide lift photos of the underbody coolant pipes, jack points, rockers and front subframe?
Was the car driven in Colorado winters or stored? Was it garaged?
Can you share an OBD-II scan showing no stored or pending codes (P0420/P0421, misfire, ABS, EPS)?
Can you post a cold-start video from fully cold, including idle for 60 seconds?
What are the DOT date codes on the Vredestein tires?
Is the clutch original? Does it slip in 4th or 5th under full throttle?
Are there any water stains behind the seats or in the footwells, and when were the top drains last cleared?
Will you allow a mobile PPI inspector in the Castle Rock area to inspect the car before the auction ends?
ppi_focus: Lift inspection of the steel coolant pipes, clamps, jack points, rockers and rear suspension mounts for mag-chloride corrosion.
Cooling-system pressure test and condition of the radiator and hoses.
Spark plug condition and evidence of oil burning; compression or leak-down if feasible.
Exhaust manifold/pre-cat rattle check and a full OBD-II scan including the ABS and EPS modules.
Clutch engagement point, slip test and shift-cable bushing play at the transaxle and shifter.
Soft top fit, header and rear-bow seals, glass-window defroster function, and the bulkhead drains.
Engine and transaxle mounts, and condition of the original bushings and dampers.
Brake caliper function and fluid condition after low-use years.
Odometer and wear consistency (pedals, seat bolster, shifter) against 30k miles.
what_would_change_verdict: Up: service receipts plus a measured oil-consumption figure and clean underbody lift photos.
Up: the seller permits a PPI before close and it comes back clean.
Down: corrosion on the coolant pipes or jack points, signs of oil burning, or stored catalyst codes.
Down: a Carfax mileage trail that conflicts with 30k, or bidding that climbs well past the comps.
evidence.mission_note: A stock 5-speed facelift MR2 fits the enthusiast-bridge brief: it is a manual, Toyota-simple and easy to resell, and its likely price sits within the ideal band. It is a weekend roadster with almost no storage, not one of the primary named bridge candidates.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes identity: the VIN decodes to a 2003 MR2 convertible with the 1.8L four and no contradictions. It also claims a five-speed manual, the facelift glass rear window, one-family ownership from about 600 miles, a clean CO title in the seller's name, a claimed clean Carfax, and tires mounted in 2026. Nothing wrong is observed or disclosed. However, the captured text contains no service records, no oil-consumption data, no OBD scan and no underbody photos. The photo gallery was not captured, so these areas are open rather than negative. The model-defining risks remain unproven: 1ZZ oil consumption, pre-cat health, coolant-pipe and jack-point corrosion on a Colorado car, and age items on low-use rubber. The $5,500 bid is an early figure. Comparable low-mile examples suggest a hammer in the mid-teens to high-teens, at or above the mileage-adjusted fair value mid of $13,914.
evidence.next_action: Post a BaT comment or message the seller requesting the Carfax, service receipts, an oil top-up history, underbody lift photos, an OBD-II scan and a cold-start video, and ask permission for a mobile PPI in Castle Rock before October 22.
